ideas.pitch: An AI-powered audio diagnostic and workflow assistant for PDS ration shop owners to handle biometric authentication failures without locking out beneficiaries.
ideas.problem_statement: AI for All: The Fingerprint That Won't Match
ideas.title: AadhaarSetu: Voice-First Fingerprint Failure Resolution Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a hyper-localized administrative failure common in Madhya Pradesh public distribution systems, leveraging a multi-lingual workflow that directly aligns with the hackathon's mandate of deep case study analysis.

ideas.pitch: A forecasting dashboard and simulation tool predicting micro-level certified seed demand anomalies across MP districts before distribution windows open.
ideas.problem_statement: AI in Agriculture: The Token Before the Seed
ideas.title: BijaNiti: Subsidized Token Supply chain Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs rigorous forecasting methodology and confidence intervals similar to past winning entries, presenting tangible economic mitigation for agricultural supply chain bottlenecks.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first multilingual voice assistant that helps ASHA workers document and score vital signs during the critical first 28 days of an infant's life.
ideas.problem_statement: AI in Healthcare: The First 28 Days
ideas.title: AshaScribe: Neonatal Triage & Early Warning Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on high-impact primary healthcare delivery in rural settings, offering a clear measurable social impact and intuitive voice-to-text safety nets.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven audio intelligence platform that aggregates, cleans, and indexes oral folk music traditions and lesser-known gharanas of Gwalior.
ideas.problem_statement: AI in Tourism: The City of Music Nobody Hears
ideas.title: TansenPulse: Acoustic Heritage Preservation Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly honors local cultural heritage (Gwalior as UNESCO City of Music) using unstructured data transformation techniques that won major data & design prizes.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent telemetry simulator tracking satellite hotspot data and meteorological vectors across October to predict stubble-smoke drift toward urban centers.
ideas.problem_statement: AI for Energy and Environment: The October Smoke
ideas.title: DhuanGuard: Stubble Burning Air Quality Simulation
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes a multi-agent architectural diagnostic approach that scores high on technical execution and addresses an urgent environmental crisis familiar to regional judges.
